items.text: Would you be the same person if you'd grown up in different surroundings?

level1.label: 条件状语从句
level1.text: if you'd grown up in different surroundings

items.text: How might you be different if you'd grown up in an urban versus a rural environment, or in a different country altogether?

level1.label: 条件状语从句
level1.text: if you'd grown up in an urban versus a rural environment, or in a different country altogether

items.text: This is the age-old, nature-nurture debate that has had people pondering for many years.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: the age-old, nature-nurture debate that has had people pondering for many years

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: that has had people pondering for many years

items.text: Is your personality written in your genes or shaped by your experience?
Most experts agree that it is a combination of both.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that it is a combination of both

items.text: Let's hear about ways this can be put to the test.
A common way is to study twin pairs, because if personality came only from genes, you might expect identical twins to have the same, or a very similar, personality.

level1.label: 原因状语从句
level1.text: because if personality came only from genes, you might expect identical twins to have the same, or a very similar, personality

level2.label: 条件状语从句
level2.text: if personality came only from genes

items.text: Research called 'Meta-analysis of the heritability of human traits based on fifty years of twin studies' looked at 14 million twin pairs in 39 countries.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: Research called 'Meta-analysis of the heritability of human traits based on fifty years of twin studies'

level2.label: 后置定语
level2.text: called 'Meta-analysis of the heritability of human traits based on fifty years of twin studies'

items.text: Do identical twins, who share almost identical DNA, have more similar personalities than nonidentical twins, who share about half?

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: identical twins, who share almost identical DNA

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: more similar personalities than nonidentical twins, who share about half

items.text: By comparing the two, the authors concluded that about 50% of the differences between people can be explained by genetic factors, meaning that our genes play a significant role in shaping who we are, but our environment and experiences are just as important.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that about 50% of the differences between people can be explained by genetic factors

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: meaning that our genes play a significant role in shaping who we are, but our environment and experiences are just as important

level2.label: 宾语从句
level2.text: that our genes play a significant role in shaping who we are, but our environment and experiences are just as important

items.text: Other studies looked to see whether personality traits were more prevalent in certain geographical regions than in others.

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: to see whether personality traits were more prevalent in certain geographical regions than in others

level2.label: 宾语从句
level2.text: whether personality traits were more prevalent in certain geographical regions than in others

items.text: For example, in a 2015 study called 'Regional Personality Differences in Great Britain', researchers investigated how the 'Big Five' personality traits, which include extraversion, openness and agreeableness, were geographically distributed.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: how the 'Big Five' personality traits, which include extraversion, openness and agreeableness, were geographically distributed

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: which include extraversion, openness and agreeableness

items.text: They found there were areas where each trait was more prevalent.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: there were areas where each trait was more prevalent

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: where each trait was more prevalent

items.text: For example, agreeableness, which is about friendliness and trust, was more prevalent in the Scottish Highlands and Northern England - more rural areas with lower population densities.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: agreeableness, which is about friendliness and trust

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: which is about friendliness and trust

items.text: Whereas openness, which is associated with curiosity and intellect, was more prevalent in urban, densely populated areas like London, Manchester and Brighton, suggesting that a person's environment can help to foster various traits.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: openness, which is associated with curiosity and intellect

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: more prevalent in urban, densely populated areas like London, Manchester and Brighton

level1.label: 状语
level1.text: suggesting that a person's environment can help to foster various traits

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: which is associated with curiosity and intellect

level2.label: 宾语从句
level2.text: that a person's environment can help to foster various traits

items.text: While our DNA provides a starting point, it is only part of the jigsaw puzzle that makes our personality.

level1.label: 让步状语从句
level1.text: While our DNA provides a starting point

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: only part of the jigsaw puzzle that makes our personality

items.text: As we go through life, we encounter obstacles, we make mistakes, and we learn what we enjoy through experience - all of which can change how we interact with the world.

level1.label: 定语从句
level1.text: all of which can change how we interact with the world

level2.label: 宾语从句
level2.text: how we interact with the world
